name: io.github.dfrancislyondflabc-tech/agentic-recall
title: agentic-recall
description: Long-term memory for agentic tasks. It tells you when it doesn't know.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the folder holding your markdown memories. Required — the server never searches your disk for it.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Where the embedding model cache, vector cache and indexes are kept. Defaults beside the code for a clone, ~/.agentic-recall for a package install.
